subject.title: fix(mattermost): backfill thread history from server when in-memory window is empty

question: Should PR #93243 be the canonical Mattermost thread-backfill fix, or should maintainers prefer a sibling candidate such as #93865?
rationale: The patch is viable and has no remaining narrow repair finding, but there are multiple open candidate PRs for the same session-state bug and the bounded inbound REST fetch is a maintainer-owned tradeoff.

options.title: Refresh And Land #93243
options.body: Use this branch as the canonical fix after a current-main refresh or merge check verifies recent Mattermost thread and media behavior still survives.

options.title: Prefer #93865
options.body: Use the sibling branch if maintainers prefer its broader test/proof shape, then close or supersede #93243 after that branch lands.

options.title: Pause For Different Policy
options.body: Keep the PR open but do not land if maintainers want a different recovery retry, timeout, or session-key policy before accepting server backfill.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Land #93243
recommendation.body: Use this branch as the canonical fix after a current-main refresh or merge check verifies recent Mattermost thread and media behavior still survives.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice crosses Mattermost monitor behavior and shared channel history semantics that recent inbound-context refactor work touched.
